reply: The crash this describes could not happen: Station._num (bus/station.py, near line 9743) does not parse a value. It checks the type and returns True only for an int or float that is not a bool, so float() only ever received a number. The suggested fix would have added a bug: since := self._num(...) binds the bool, so every wait would start at float(True) == 1.0. The new head still reads each saved since value once and converts exactly the value _num checked, so the guard and the conversion clearly match. A new test, test_a_saved_wait_start_that_is_not_a_number_is_left_out, pins the behavior: 0 and 5.5 are kept, and a string, None, True, a missing key and a non-dict entry are left out.
